assay: purified recombinant human PHGDH enzyme inhibition
source_location: Results/Table 1; Online Methods: protein expression and PHGDH assay
evidence_summary: NCT-503 inhibits recombinant human PHGDH with reported IC50 2.5 +/- 0.6 micromolar. This assay does not establish potency against mouse PHGDH or osteoclast efficacy.
transfer_assumptions: Human PHGDH assay transferred to mouse PHGDH as an explicit hypothesis; mouse potency, selectivity, cellular exposure and genetic-to-drug equivalence are not established by this assay.
pharmacology_caveats: PHGDH-independent metabolic effects reported in neuroblastoma including knockout cells (PMID:34192988); this does not negate target binding but limits single-target attribution of cellular effects.
